question: I cast Scent of Brine and want to reveal blue cards from my hand to make the counter cost bigger. Do I reveal those cards as part of casting it?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you reveal the cards as Scent of Brine resolves.

whyHard: Players treat the reveal as a cost paid at casting rather than part of the spell's effect.
